title: Where is it
prompt: Return the position of value in the array, or -1 if it is not there.
signature: func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
	return 0
hint: Arrays have a find method that already returns -1 when nothing matches.
solution:
func solve(items: Array, value: int) -> int:
	return items.find(value)
